description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of tokens and an unspecified metric across four different categories: Tutorials, Library Documentation, Github files, and StackOverflow posts. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Tokens," has a linear scale, ranges from 200 to 800, and is marked at intervals of 200. The y-axis is unlabeled, has a linear scale, ranges from 20 to 40, and is marked at intervals of 10. The plot contains four lines, each representing one of the categories: Tutorials (blue, solid line, circle markers), Library Documentation (red, solid line, triangle markers), Github files (green, solid line, circle markers), and StackOverflow posts (yellow, solid line, circle markers). The blue line (Tutorials) starts at approximately 22 on the y-axis at 200 tokens and increases to around 45 at 800 tokens. The red line (Library Documentation) begins at about 23 on the y-axis at 200 tokens and rises to roughly 43 at 800 tokens, with a slight dip to 42 at 1000 tokens. The green line (Github files) starts at approximately 30 on the y-axis at 200 tokens, increases to around 47 at 800 tokens, and then decreases to about 45 at 1000 tokens. The yellow line (StackOverflow posts) begins at around 35 on the y-axis at 200 tokens, remains relatively steady until 400 tokens, and then declines to approximately 30 at 800 tokens and further to around 28 at 1000 tokens.
